title: Understanding the Role of \( \hat{\theta} \)
text: In the context of the problem, \( \hat{\theta} \) is the parameter estimate obtained from the training data using ridge regression. It is not a fixed quantity in the true model but rather a result of the estimation process.

title: True Model vs. Estimated Model
text: The true model is represented by \( f_{\theta**{*}}(X_i) \), where \( \theta**{*} \) is the true parameter. \( \hat{\theta} \) is an estimate derived from the data, not a fixed parameter in the true model.
